title: Returned Payment Points in the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Refinance Down Payment
content:
A Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract with returned payments carries percentage points of the balloon amount toward the refinance down payment:

- where a balloon returned payment posted in the 12 calendar months ending on the payment date, the contract carries 2.0 percentage points;
- where none posted in those months but one or more posted in the 24 calendar months ending on the payment date, it carries 1.0;
- otherwise it carries none for returned payments.

A window of N calendar months ending on the payment date takes in the dates on or before the payment date that fall fewer than N whole calendar months before it.

| Most recent balloon returned payment | Points |
|---|---|
| Within 12 months | 2.0 |
| Over 12 but within 24 months | 1.0 |
| None within 24 months | None |
